title: Nobody on our bowling team bowls when the fifth row lights up
description:
I'm new at the warehouse, and on Thursdays my workmates take me bowling. From my first frame they gave me a nickname, and one rule I didn't understand.

Three lanes down, in the dark behind the pins, somebody in our team shirt was standing very still. Every week it was one lane nearer ours.

It's made up: a creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have stepped up when the fifth row lit up?
